verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Git Sync connects collections/environments directly to a Git repo and provides a merge view to review and resolve conflicts, plus AI-assisted commit messages, giving solid versioning and review capabilities for automations like pre-request scripts and collection runs. However, there's no explicit documentation of a 'rollback' action (reverting to prior commits) and no AI-native-specific automation versioning workflow beyond generic Git usage. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert feature documentation, AI-native-tailored version control workflow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the review/rollback experience.
